summary: 齐王芳废后迎立，好学明经，志在剪除司马氏；甘露五年率宿卫讨司马昭，于南阙下被弑，时年二十。
summary_en: Called to the throne after Cao Fang's deposition, he was a scholar-emperor set on rooting out the Simas; in the 5th year of Ganlu he led his guards against Sima Zhao and was slain beneath the southern gate, aged twenty.

portrait.appearance_basis: 史载无形貌描写。画像宜表现英锐尚学、不甘傀儡的少年君主之态，衣冠从曹魏甘露制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 文帝孙，东海定王霖之子。
timeline.summary_en: Grandson of Emperor Wen, son of Cao Lin, Prince Ding of Donghai.

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 齐王芳废，司马师迎立高贵乡公，改元正元。
timeline.summary_en: With Cao Fang deposed, Sima Shi summoned the duke of Gaogui District to the throne; the era was changed to Zhengyuan.

timeline.title: 毌丘俭文钦反
timeline.summary: 扬州都督毌丘俭、文钦起兵讨司马师，师亲征平之，俭死钦奔吴。
timeline.summary_en: The Yangzhou commander Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin rose against Sima Shi; Shi campaigned in person, Jian died, and Qin fled to Wu.

timeline.title: 诸葛诞反
timeline.summary: 征东大将军诸葛诞据寿春反，司马昭围城年馀，诞败死。
timeline.summary_en: The general Zhuge Dan rose from Shouchun; Sima Zhao besieged the city for over a year until Dan fell and died.

timeline.title: 讨司马昭被弑
timeline.title_en: The Rising against Sima Zhao and the Slaying
timeline.summary: 帝率殿中宿卫鼓噪出讨，司马昭党贾充命成济弑帝于南阙下；事见汉晋春秋裴注。
timeline.summary_en: The emperor sallied forth with his palace guards, and Jia Chong of Sima Zhao's party ordered Cheng Ji to slay him beneath the southern gate — as the Han–Jin Annals, quoted by Pei Songzhi, records.

timeline.title: 立常道乡公
timeline.summary: 弑帝后，司马昭迎立常道乡公奂，即魏元帝。
timeline.summary_en: After the slaying, Sima Zhao installed Cao Huan, marquis of Changdao District, who became the last Wei emperor.

relations.note: 嘉平六年废齐王芳，迎立高贵乡公
relations.note_en: In the sixth year of Jiaping, deposed Fang, Prince of Qi, and welcomed in the Duke of Gaoguixiang

relations.note: 甘露五年被弑，立常道乡公奂
relations.note_en: Ganlu 5: assassinated; Huan, Duke of Changdao Township, is enthroned

bio_md:
# 高贵乡公 · 主要事迹

曹髦字彦士，文帝孙，东海定王曹霖之子，封高贵乡公。嘉平六年，齐王芳被废，司马师迎立髦，年十三，改元正元。髦好学有成人之量，即位后屡与诸儒论经于朝堂，有「帝王之学」之誉；然政柄在司马氏，正元二年毌丘俭、文钦起兵讨师，甘露二年诸葛诞据寿春反昭，皆不平而败。

甘露五年五月，帝以司马昭弑君之心日显，召侍中王沈、尚书王经等密议，曰：「司马昭之心，路人所知也。吾不能坐受废辱，今日当与卿等自出讨之。」遂率殿中宿卫苍头官僮鼓噪而出，自讨司马昭。昭之党羽贾充命成济抽戈犯跸，帝崩于南阙之下，年二十。以天子之尊，冲锋蹈刃，亘古未有，事见《汉晋春秋》裴注。

帝既弑，司马昭以太后令罪帝「悖逆不道」，废为庶人，迎立常道乡公曹奂。后世论曹髦：以英锐之资，处必亡之势，明知不济而为之，其节可哀，其志可敬。三国之君，自汉献帝以下，皆苟且图存，独高贵乡公以死殉社稷——「司马昭之心」成语流传千古，正是民心所向的定评。

> 参考：点校本《三国志》卷004《三少帝纪》及裴注引《汉晋春秋》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Cao Mao, styled Yanshi, was a grandson of Emperor Wen, son of Cao Lin, Prince Ding of Donghai, enfeoffed Duke of Gaogui District. In the 6th year of Jiaping, after Cao Fang's deposition, Sima Shi installed Mao at thirteen, changing the era to Zhengyuan. He was a student with an adult's gravity, debating the classics with the scholars at court, earning the name of a philosopher-sovereign; but the government lay with the Simas. In the 2nd year of Zhengyuan Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin rose against Shi; in the 2nd year of Ganlu Zhuge Dan rose from Shouchun against Sima Zhao — both rose and both fell without result.

In the fifth month of the 5th year of Ganlu, with Sima Zhao's ambition plain, the emperor summoned Wang Shen, Wang Jing, and the others and said: "Sima Zhao's heart is known to every man on the road. I cannot sit and await disgrace — today I shall go out against him myself." He sallied forth with his palace guards, servants, and lads against Sima Zhao. Jia Chong of Zhao's party ordered Cheng Ji to strike; the emperor was slain beneath the southern gate, aged twenty. That an emperor should charge the spears in person was unheard of — the deed is recorded in the *Han–Jin Annals*, preserved in Pei Songzhi's commentary.

After the slaying, Sima Zhao blamed the emperor by the empress dowager's edict, degraded him to commoner, and installed Cao Huan, marquis of Changdao District. Posterity judges Cao Mao: of sharp spirit in a doomed position, he acted knowing he could not win — his constancy is pitiable, his resolve admirable. Of the Three Kingdoms' emperors, from Emperor Xian on, all clung to life; only the Duke of Gaogui District died for his altars. "Sima Zhao's heart" has passed into the language as the verdict of the people.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Sanguozhi*, ch. 4 ("Annals of the Three Young Sovereigns") and the commentary citing the *Han–Jin Annals*.
